mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 50k and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1pp in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when HOUST declines by at least 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a further increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by at least 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5%, it signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances where HOUST declines by at least 2% and RSAFS declines by at least 1% in the same month.
